required_behaviors: Accepts a List[float] of at least two elements and returns Tuple[float, float] ordered (smaller, larger)
Returns the pair with the minimal absolute difference among all possible pairs
When multiple pairs have the same minimal difference, returns the pair that appears first in the sorted-order scan
Duplicate values are supported; returns (x, x) when the closest pair is a duplicated value
Raises ValueError when the input list has fewer than two elements
The output tuple always has a <= b (non-decreasing order)

Catching and silently swallowing exceptions instead of propagating ValueError
